newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Pictet starts Sulzer Medica as hold. [CORRECTED 11:34 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pictet starts Sulzer Medica as hold. [CORRECTED 11:34 GMT]

text.p: Pictet & Cie started coverage of medical technology maker Sulzer Medica AG with a "hold" recommendation for the Swiss-listed registered share.
Pictet said it remained positive on the company's prospects but said Sulzer was trading at a high price compared to when it started trading on July 14 (corrects from June 16).
"Sulzer Medica is trading at roughly 22.5 times prospective earnings for 1998, a valuation fully in line with those of industry peers," the Geneva-based private bank said in a report.
